publisher: New Jersey Department of Environmental Protection / Department of Children and Families
ownership: Official public NJDEP distribution of DCF-derived licensed childcare center locations.
allowed_use: fixed public HTTPS layer, item, raw publisher metadata, count, date, ID inventory and selected-field queries
immutable internal selected source retention with complete publisher metadata and terms
local-review normalization preserving attribution, source CRS and semantic limitations
prohibited_use: acquiring owner, director, center_phone, center_email or undeclared record attributes
inferring current business operation, occupancy, ownership or corporate parents from center names or active-layer membership
claiming complete childcare or unique-business coverage from licensed-center counts
treating New Jersey public-school inclusion as the same denominator as Massachusetts center-based exclusions
inferring closure from disappearance or source edits
redistributing records or aggregate outputs as authorized by this release without a separate export approval
attribution: New Jersey Department of Environmental Protection; New Jersey Department of Children and Families
publisher_notice_requirement: Retain complete distribution terms in source-observation.json item payloads and publisher-metadata.xml unchanged. Any separately authorized reproduction or derived publication must accompany the data with complete publisher metadata and carry the prescribed NJDEP credit/disclaimer, not substitute generic attribution. Coordinate-reference integrity and third-party rights remain applicable.
coordinate_handling: Retain source WKID 102100/latest 3857 evidence and explicit requested WGS84 4326 transformation. Normalized business records contain nullable latitude/longitude only; retained selected point features remain internal evidence.
retention: Immutable local source evidence; operator-governed deletion. Ordinary failed staging remains inspectable. No automatic retention cleanup is implemented.
redistribution: Not authorized by this release; local-review-only. Public source access and retained terms are not legal approval or evidence of unrestricted third-party rights.
personal_data_handling: Names and reported addresses may identify natural persons or sensitive locations. Selected raw evidence stays internal; normalized records stay local-review-only. Owner, director, phone and email fields are excluded at query time.

evidence.basis: Independent bounded public production layer/item/count/date inspection and raw publisher metadata utility evidence; full retained release metadata remains authoritative for each acquired version.
evidence.limitations: Licensed-center scope includes facilities operating in public schools, unlike Massachusetts. Family-home registration and licensing exemptions are separate. Publisher download date, item modification and observation time are distinct; neither layer membership nor license dates prove current operations. No unique-business, current USPS or nationwide completeness denominator is established.
